styles.loose: Find the cheapest flight from Warsaw to Lisbon next month and tell me its price and dates
styles.goal: Find the cheapest round-trip flight from Warsaw to Lisbon next month. Result: the price in PLN and the travel dates.
styles.steps: 1. Set the origin to Warsaw and the destination to Lisbon. 2. Look at next month's prices (calendar or price graph). 3. Pick the cheapest round trip. Result: its price in PLN and its dates.

check.pattern: cheapest round-trip flight from Warsaw to Lisbon is currently (PLN\W?[\d,]+)
